value.rationale: This is a natural complete all-size classification of monitor placements on a standard infinite two-parameter graph family. It supplies exact count of every placement size, explicit exponentially growing minimum-placement multiplicities and complete maximal obstruction antichain; all-k coefficient-saturation threshold is sharp. These strengthen the known minimum-size value and are not arbitrary finite computations.
